tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zlog me'i spu gri'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag yang zlog me'i spu gri'i lo rgyus ni| sngon byung 'das pa'i dus na lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas/ dur khrod chen po gtum drag gi tshandha zhes bya ba na/ rin po che dang dur khrod rngam pa'i gzhal yas khang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba grangs las 'das pas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus na/ ma he dang*/ glang po che dang*/ gshin rje 'bum dang*/ klu 'bum/ gnyan khri/ sa bdag stong bsnol ba'i khri steng na/ padma zla nyi 'bar ba'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro rngam 'bar ba brkyang bskum rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i 'khor du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ gzhan yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'khor nam mkha'i skar tshogs las kyang ches mang ba dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so// de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed pos 'jam dpal thugs kyi gsang rgyud rtsa ba chen po 'chad par bzhed do// thams cad skrag byed ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// snyoms par zhugs ma thag dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad 'dar zhing zhum nas dpa' bkong bar byas te/ thugs ye shes kyi 'od zer spros pa'i rtse la 'khor lo dang*| gnam lcags kyi zer dang*/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog /dril bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang*/ ha la la dang*/ hu lu hu lu dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e ā ra li hrīṃ hrīṃ/ zhes 'brug stong gi sgra ltar bsgrags pas/ dregs pa can rnams dbang du bsdus shing tshar bcad ma thag /dregs pa can rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la btud de skyabs su gsol ba'i tshe de dag bde ba la bkod nas/

mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug lag na rdo rje stan las langs nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed la gus pas gsol ba btab cing dregs byed rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi srog snying phul nas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa dang*/ chos 'khor bshig pa'i ru tra la sogs pa zhing bcur gyur pa rnams/ khyod rnams kyis 'dul ba'i zas skal gyis las sems can yongs la 'tshe ba ma byed cig /ces bka' bsgos dam la bzhag nas/ 'khor rnams la zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rtsa rgyud chen po le'u bzhi pa dang*/ zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud le'u brgyad pa dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor sdig pa snying la ru 'dzing ba'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa dang*/ drag po sngags rgod sdig pa snying 'dzing snying po don gyi rgyud ces bya ba bsam gtan lha yul du grags pa le'u bdun pa dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ sgos brgyud la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pas 'khor yi rangs par mdzad/ rgyud de rnams mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug lag na rdo rjes legs par bsdus nas slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje la gtad/ des 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gtad/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rtsa rgyud tshangs pa klu gnon gyi bse'i ka bar sbas nas/ rgyud gzhan rnams slob dpon shantiṃ garbha la gnang*/ des gtsug lag dpal dge la gnang*/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dges rgyud de rnams kyi nang nas srung zlog bsad mnan gyi gdams pa zab dgu bsdus te/ yang zlog me'i spu gri zhes mtshan du gsol nas slob dpon padma la gnang*/ des bal po ba su dha ra la gnang*/ bal po ba su dha ra'i gcung po zhig gnubs yul rong du tshe 'phos pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes su grags pa de nyid sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis bal yul yam bu tshal du bal po ba su dha ra'i drung du lan bdun byon pa'i snga mo rnams kyi dus/

bal po ba su dha ras rgyud rnams legs par gnang ste/ bal yul gyi skad du bsgyur zhing nyan bshad sgom sgrub kyis gtan la phab/ phyi ma 'byon pa'i tshe yang zlog me'i spu gri'i skor rnams gab sbas med par gnang ba'i mjug tu bal po ba su dha ras 'jam dpal gyi sku zhig gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dbu thog tu bzhag nas gzhan la mi spel ba'i bka' rgyas btab/ gnubs kyis kyang bod du byon nas rgyud rnams dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de gdams pa 'di nyid da lta spel ba'i dus min pas/ snyigs ma lnga bdo'i tshe sngags pa las 'phro can dang phrad nas/ ban dgra nag po tshar gcod par shog ces pa'i smon lam btab nas lho brag mkho mthing gi lha khang dang*/ phung po ri bo che gnyis su tshar re sbas so// phung po ri bo che'i gter kha ni las dang skal par ldan pa'i gter ston rgya zhang khrom gyis bton nas lha rje gnubs chung la gnang*/ lha rje gnubs chung gis kyang lho brag mkho mthing du gter yod pa shes nas bton/ de'i tshe mtshur ston rin chen rdo rjes spong zhon ston chung pha bu rnams la mthu byas pa'i tshe/ dol po mes ston gyis zlog pa byas pas cho 'phrul chen po byung ba dang*/ mtshur ston rin rdor gyis kha rag lha mo dbang phyug rdo rje'i spyan sngar phyin nas lo rgyus bshad pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ mes ston pa zhes bya ba gtsang gi rgyal khams na zlog pa khong las lhag pa med/ nga la zlog pa yang zhun ma la sogs pa yod de/ des kyang mi 'ong*/ khyod rang phyag rgya dang ur mo la mkhas kyang mi 'ong*/ yang zlog zab pa zhig dgos pa yin pas/ de lta bu lha rje gnubs chung la yod pas/ khong gi drung du song zhig ces gsungs pas/ snam bu tshos ma bubs bdun khyer nas gtsang du lha rje gnubs chung gi drung du phyin nas de dag phul te/ yang zlog gi gdams pa zhus pas thor bu tsam zhig gnang bas tshims nas tshur ldog ste bsgrubs pas cho 'phrul cher song*/

slar rta pho ngang zhur gcig /gser srang 'ga' yar khyer nas lha rje gnubs chung gi drung du phyin te de rnams phul nas| sngar gnang ba'i gdams pa 'di cha lag ma tshang ba 'dra bas cha lag tshang ba zhig zhu/ de mi gnang na nga rang gi 'bul ba tshur 'khyer dgos/ 'di'i cho ga byas pas cho 'phrul cher song zhus pas/ lha rje gnubs chung gis sngags kyi sham 'dogs lha'i sgom thabs la sogs pa cha tshang ba gnang nas gdams pa 'di la lhag ma bzhag re zhes dbu snyung bzhes/ mtshur ston gyis kyang rang gi rgyud pa min pa gzhan la mi ston pa'i mna' bskyal nas tshur log ste/ mtshur ston rin rdor rang dang khong rang gi sras 'jam dpal lo bco brgyad lon pa dang*/ mtshur ston dbang nge lo bco lnga lon pa kho rang yab sras gsum gyis 'di'i ca ga byas te srung zlog bsad pa'i sngags rgyun byas pas/ mes ston dpon g.yog bzhi khrag tu bskyugs nas shi/ slar spong zhon ston chung bu bdun pho ngo drug cu rtsa gcig liṅga la btab nas gdams pa 'di nyid nyams su blangs pas spong zhon pa pha bu pho ngo drug cu rtsa gcig dang bcas pa zla ba dgu'i khongs su bsgral/ de lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo yang zlog me'i spu gri 'di mtshur ston rin chen rdo rjes sku zhang dpal la gnang*/ des tshul khrims rin chen/ des byang chub mgon po/ des nam mkha'i mtshan can/ des tshul khrims mtshan can/ des rgya ston dbon po rig 'dzin gsang ba/ des rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ratna'i mtshan can la phul zhing*| rig 'dzin chen po ratna'i mtshan can gyis thugs nyams su bzhes pas zhal dngos su lan grangs mang du gzigs shing*/ drod tshad mthar phyin par mdzad cing rje btsun dharma'i mtshan can la gnang*/ dam pa des kyang thugs nyams su bzhes shing zhal dngos su lan mang du gzigs nas mtshungs med maṅga'i mtshan can la gnang*/ rje des thugs nyams su bzhes shing zhal dngos su gzigs pa lan 'ga' yar dang bcas bdag la thugs dgyes bzhin du bstsal zhing bdag gis kyang nyams su bstar ba'i tshe zhal dngos su lan mang du mthong zhing rjes su bzung ste/

lhag pa'i lhar bzung bas bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu yang dag pa 'byin zhing gnas skabs su phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du 'grub cing mthar thug sku lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang bde blag tu 'grub pa la gor ma chag pa'i yi dam 'di lta bu ni/ gsang chen bla na med pa rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying zab bcud du gyur zhing the tshom dang bral ba yid ches pa'i gnas kho nar mchis so// zhes pa'ang sngon chad yang zlog me'i spu gri la gtsug lag dpal dge phyin las de yan gyi lo rgyus gsal bar mi 'dug pas/ zla gsang gi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam thar dang*/ rje btsun dam pa ratna'i mtshan can yab sras kyi gsan yig sogs las legs par btus shing go bde 'khyer sla bar/ dpal 'bri gung pa chen po'i skyu ra'i gdung las bcu gnyis pa'i thog tu gnas pa/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas lcags mo lug lo rang lo so bdun gyi steng*/ dbo zla ba'i dkar cha'i dga' ba gnyis par pho brang chen po bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
